45	// Running weighted average per lot
46	const lots = computed(() => {
47	  let shares = 0
48	  let totalCost = 0
49	  return transactions.value.map((tx) => {
50	    if (tx.type === 'buy') {
51	      totalCost += tx.shares * tx.price
52	      shares += tx.shares
53	    } else {
54	      totalCost -= (totalCost / shares) * tx.shares
55	      shares -= tx.shares
56	    }
57	    const avgCost = shares > 0 ? totalCost / shares : 0
58	    return { ...tx, runningShares: shares, runningAvg: avgCost }
59	  })
60	})
61	
62	// Full summary including all fees and taxes paid
63	const summary = computed(() => {
64	  if (!lots.value.length) return null
65	  const last = lots.value[lots.value.length - 1]
66	  const shares = last.runningShares
67	  const avgCost = last.runningAvg
68	  const totalCost = shares * avgCost
69	
70	  // Accumulate fees & taxes from all lots
71	  let totalBuyFees = 0
72	  let totalSellFees = 0
73	  let totalTax = 0
74	  let realizedGross = 0   // sell proceeds before fees/tax
75	  let realizedNet = 0     // sell proceeds after fees/tax
76	
77	  for (const tx of transactions.value) {
78	    if (tx.type === 'buy') {
79	      totalBuyFees += tx.feeAmount || 0
80	    } else {
81	      totalSellFees += tx.feeAmount || 0
82	      totalTax += tx.taxAmount || 0
83	      realizedGross += tx.total || 0
84	      realizedNet += tx.netProceeds != null ? tx.netProceeds : (tx.total - (tx.feeAmount || 0) - (tx.taxAmount || 0))
85	    }
86	  }
87	
88	  const totalFees = totalBuyFees + totalSellFees
89	  const currentValue = currentPrice.value != null ? shares * currentPrice.value : null
90	
91	  // Gross P&L = current value - cost basis (ignores fees/tax)
92	  const grossPnl = currentValue != null ? currentValue - totalCost : null
93	  const grossPnlPct = avgCost > 0 && currentPrice.value != null
94	    ? ((currentPrice.value - avgCost) / avgCost) * 100 : null
